::: {.piege .piege-statique}
```r
# project frozen with an old version of renv, on Windows or macOS
renv::restore()
```
:::

This pitfall depends on an old version of {renv} and on a network service that is gone, so it cannot be replayed in the browser.

## Why

MRAN was the daily CRAN snapshot run by Microsoft. On Windows and macOS, old versions of {renv} looked there for binaries of old package versions. Microsoft shut the service down in 2023.

A project still on an old version of {renv} therefore keeps trying to reach MRAN during `restore()`. The resulting download errors talk about addresses or connections, not about MRAN being closed. {renv} 1.0.0 turned this integration off by default, and the option is now marked as deprecated.

## The fix

Turn MRAN off before restoring, then update {renv} in the project.

::: {.piege .piege-statique}
```r
options(renv.config.mran.enabled = FALSE)
renv::restore()
renv::upgrade()
```
:::
